## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

Every hit is recognisable in the console output of `tk test`: the runner marks each hit's per-test result `recorded` (spec §2).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A hit's console line or details show `recorded`
- [ ] A fresh pass shows no marker
- [ ] Exit codes are unchanged

title: Hits are marked `recorded` per target
